title: Notification include has no route coverage
reasoning: The feature adds the notifications URL include, but the provided linked tests exercise Armenian text, Bible API/text fetching, devotionals, email behavior, fast views, and feast admin icon actions. None assert that the notifications include resolves, imports successfully, or exposes the expected endpoint names under the mounted prefix. A typo or missing dependency inside notifications.urls would therefore be caught only by broad URLConf import coverage or runtime traffic, not by feature-specific tests.
recommendation: Add a focused URL test that imports/resolves the notifications route through the project URL prefix and verifies at least one expected notification endpoint name or response behavior.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included context tests do not reference /notifications/, notifications.urls, URL resolving for the include, or any notification endpoint behavior.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a Django URL resolver test for the mounted /hub/notifications/ path, or a client test for a representative notifications endpoint if notifications.urls defines concrete views.
minimumFixScope: Test-only change covering the notifications include and one representative child route.
